CONSUMER LOAN AGREEMENT

Lender: Nordbank AG, registered in Germany, HRB 123456, supervised by BaFin.
Borrower: as specified in the application.

Loan amount: 15,000 EUR
Interest rate: 6.9% APR, subject to a standard credit check (Schufa) and
proof of income.

Disbursement occurs within 3-5 business days after all documents have
been verified and the loan agreement has been signed by both parties.

No fees are charged prior to disbursement. All applicable fees are
included in the stated APR and disclosed in the pre-contractual
information sheet.

You may reach our customer service by phone, email, postal mail, or
through our secure online banking portal. A WhatsApp business channel
is also available for quick questions.

Right of withdrawal: You may withdraw from this agreement within 14 days
without giving reasons, in accordance with statutory consumer protection
law.

Nordbank AG, Frankfurt am Main
